content:
Compute \(v_5(n!)=\sum_{k\ge1}\left\lfloor \frac n{5^k}\right\rfloor\).

Check around \(n=1160\):

\[
v_5(1160!)=\left\lfloor\frac{1160}{5}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{1160}{25}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{1160}{125}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{1160}{625}\right\rfloor
=232+46+9+1=288.
\]

At \(n=1165\):

\[
233+46+9+1=289.
\]

At \(n=1170\):

\[
234+46+9+1=290.
\]

Thus the smallest \(n\) is \(\boxed{1170}\).
